sentences.text: SU Engineering Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-27 under the industry code 71121, engineering design and technical consultancy.
First sales are recorded on 2026-09-27, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-10-02.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file, and the register confidence for the entry is low.
For the fund this is a watchlist case, and the record does not show what the firm engineers.
